scenario.title: Game 4, 2007 World Series
scenario.setup: game 4, 2007 world series. bottom of the 8th. the you lead 4-3. one out, nobody on. Ryan Spilborghs is up. 5 outs and the door is shut. finish the 8th. then the 9th is yours.
sources: Retrosheet event file 2007WS.EVE, game COL200710280 (via github.com/chadwickbureau/retrosheet)
Retrosheet rosters BOS2007.ROS and COL2007.ROS for bat and throw hands

reveal.summary: Spilborghs grounded out, Hawpe flied out, Torrealba grounded out, Carroll lined out, then struck out Smith
